meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Qobuz Google one-tap sign-in, subscription pitch sections, FAQ and footer; blur or hide the album covers.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on qobuz.com/us-en/discover. Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (the machine was out of memory/network when it was retried), the web player and any logged-in page. Fixture desktop-real.html is a sanitised excerpt.

LIVE counts on discover: google-one-tap desktop home 1; hero-slider desktop home 1; promo-sections desktop home 2; covers-blur desktop home 8; covers-hide desktop home 8; faq desktop home 1; footer desktop home 1. `#g_id_onload` is the Google Identity Services config element (it exists, 1); the visible prompt is an iframe injected into `#credential_picker_container` and was not rendered in headless Chrome, so the iframe and container selectors are SOURCE (Google Identity Services documentation), not seen. Selectors: ids and readable class names (slider-header, sound-quality, gift-apps, FAQ, footer01, album-cover); the layout is Tailwind utility classes which are never used.

Choice: Album covers Show/Blur/Hide (blur 10px). The Didomi dialog (`#didomi-host`) is covered by the 1.0.0 cookie rule; its consent buttons render outside the host in a shadow tree not inspected.

NOT verified: phone layout, other regional stores (/fr-fr/), logged-in pages, whether the cookie dialog appears in a clean EU profile.
